description:
Comment "GUIDE" to get the full guide.

Claude just killed YouTube with a free skill that runs your channel.

It's called the YouTube Agent Skill.

It's actually eleven skills in one install, so Claude gets one for every part of your channel.

It already has over 6,000 stars on GitHub, and it's completely free, so you don't even need an API key.

The viral skill takes the channels in your niche and ranks every video by how far it beat that channel's normal views.

It also tells you which hook formula each title used.

Then the script skill writes five hooks from 21 formulas and scores each one before it writes the full script.

After you post, another one reads your retention export and tells you the exact second people left.

Setting it up is super simple.

You just paste the GitHub link into Claude.

#claude #youtubeagentskill #facelessyoutube #aitools #youtubeautomation
